Second line of the top bar's music player, under the song's title: which mood's list and the song's place in it. {mood} = NIGHT / LAST CALL / STORY / DAY'S END (build.player.mood_*), {at} and {of} = digits. One line, 8px body face, ~16 characters.

Line under the music player's hover tip title: the song and what the three keys do. {song} = the song's title in capitals, {at}/{of} = digits. One line, 8px body face, ~48 characters.
Title of the pause menu (Escape). Display face 24, ~10 characters.
Caption on the pause menu's amber key: back to the bar. Key 352x50, 16px body face, ~14 characters.
Caption on the pause menu's save key, greyed until saving exists. Key 352x50, 16px body face, ~14 characters.

The song's clock beside the seek bar: {at} = minutes:seconds into the song, {of} = its length, both preformatted like 1:42. Keep the two numbers and a separator.
Shown on a controls row while it waits for the player to press the key that will do that action. ~16 characters.
